scope: Public primary-source research for Neiva, Colombia. No API account created, paid service activated, browser panorama extraction or bulk municipal download.
conclusion: No downloadable, openly licensed, textured 3D survey covering Neiva was confirmed. Official 2D cartographic products and cadastral footprint services were found; they do not supply a complete, current, dimensionally verified city model.

sources.publisher: Alcaldía de Neiva, Dirección de Gestión Catastral
sources.status: Public viewer and bounded file requests returned HTTP 200/206
sources.coverage: Municipal urban construction layers are present. Complete feature count and surveyed extent were not downloaded or independently verified.
sources.license: No dataset-specific redistribution license located in the inspected configuration or official landing page.
sources.downloads: First 524288 bytes of each layer inspected with HTTP Range; no complete layer downloaded. No cadastral identifier values, owner data or raw municipal geometry copied into the repository.
sources.dateCaveat: HTTP Last-Modified is file publication metadata, not an exact field survey date.
sources.imageryCaveat: Viewer configuration exposes Google Satellite as a background, not a municipally licensed downloadable orthophoto or a 3D mesh. No Google tiles were downloaded.
sources.integration: Not imported; requires explicit dataset license and field/accuracy metadata before replacement of OSM/ML. Even with access this is planar geometry, not measured building height.

sources.status: Official metadata and coverage polygon accessible; image download/service not confirmed.
sources.license: IGAC-authored open data uses CC-BY-4.0 under Resolution 616/2020. Ownership and licensing of this registered orthophoto must be confirmed; registration alone does not establish IGAC copyright or a download right.
sources.dimensionalLimit: 10cm pixel spacing is not a certified 10cm positional accuracy. Orthophoto is 2D; no facade geometry, floor count, textured mesh or building elevation was supplied.
sources.integration: Metadata reference only; no imagery acquired or shipped.

sources.format: ArcGIS MapServer polygon feature layer U_CONSTRUCCION
sources.status: Layer schema accessible. Neiva bbox count and a request limited to five central geometries timed out at 35/45 seconds; municipality code query returned non-JSON. No Neiva feature successfully retrieved.
sources.coverage: National service extent includes Colombia; that does not prove Neiva records are present/current.
sources.license: IGAC open-data framework CC-BY-4.0, Resolution 616/2020; layer copyrightText is empty and per-record provenance not retrieved.
sources.integration: Not imported. Floor designation, if retrieved, would still not be a metric exterior building height. Only whitelisted geometric/structural attributes were requested.

sources.license: CC-BY-4.0 for the specified IGAC open data, not a blanket license over all third-party/municipal imagery.

sources.status: Both documented old links returned no route to host in this session. Superseded for this research by the currently linked 179.1.129.45:3080 portal; not evidence that municipal cadastral data do not exist.
No public item matched this exact city/type search. This does not rule out differently titled, unindexed, private or institutional scene services.

Current country table lists Colombia with one 2D tile marker, without the paired 3D marker shown for countries such as Chile/Canada, and with Maps JavaScript 3D unavailable. No current official evidence of Neiva photorealistic 3D coverage was found.
sources.license: Google Maps Platform agreement, not open-data redistribution.
sources.integration: Official API visualization requires configured credentials/account and service terms; imagery presence or Street View coverage does not supply an exportable city mesh. No API key or paid service activated.

sources.coverage: Global OSM-derived 3D building layer, updated quarterly according to the product page.
sources.license: Underlying OSM ODbL plus Cesium ion service terms for hosted access.
sources.heightPolicy: Official cesium#estimatedHeight falls back to levels times 3 metres, assuming at least one level. This does not replace missing real Neiva dimensions.
sources.integration: Not fetched. OSM-derived extrusions are not new Neiva photogrammetry or a survey of every building.

sources.license: Images shared under CC-BY-SA with image/author attribution; terms must be checked for each intended use and derivative.
sources.coverage: No authenticated Neiva imagery inventory or capture-date coverage was retrieved in this task.
sources.integration: Potential street-level reference source through official viewer/API; needs an application token for programmatic access. Image availability is not a certified city-wide metric 3D model. No token obtained, no panorama downloaded.
